summary: Run the local web check alongside the Rust build lane while holding one heavy cargo slot; stop its process group on timeout or interruption, serialize shared dependency installs and readers against the TypeScript check, buffer background output and exclude tagged candidate-runner measurements from SLO figures.

replay.detail: Local CI tooling only; no graph replay change.

schema.detail: No stored product schema change. The local run ledger gains an optional candidate commit field.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or evidence acceptance rule change.

compatibility.detail: Normal signing uses the accepted-base runner. Serial execution remains available through ST_EVIDENCE_SERIAL=1.

recovery.detail: Revert the change or use ST_EVIDENCE_SERIAL=1 to restore serial check execution.
